units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 76b:16">Snh. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא גברא דמְצַמְצְמָהּ וכ׳</he> (not <he>מא …</he>; Ms. M. <he>דצימצם</he> Hebr. Form) a man that confined his neighbor’s animal so as to expose it to sunstroke; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787:20">Yalk. Num. 787</cite> <he>דצמצמיה</he>, read: <he>דצַמְצְמָהּ</he>.

Yeb. 46ᵃ ארפו ליה וצַמְצְמוּ ליה (ed. וצימצמו, Hebr. form) they loosened the halter around his neck, and pressed it close to his neck; צ׳ ליה כי היכי וכ׳ they pressed it, in order that he (when immersing) may not anticipate them and say, I take this immersion as a freedman.—Transf. to get a person into a dilemma. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) אמר מְצַמְצְמָא יתי וכ׳ Nebuchadnezzar said, he (the Lord, in commanding me to destroy the Temple) wants to get me into trouble, that he may do unto me as he did &c.; ib. (Zabdi 2) מצמצא some ed. (corr. acc.); ib. to IV, 12.—2) (cmp. b. h. צַמָּה, v. אִיסְטְמָא) to restrain the hair from flying, to tie up, veil.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 38:15">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXVIII, 15</cite> (h. text <he>כסתה</he>).—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>צמצמתא</he> some ed., read: <he>למְצַמְּתָא</he>, v. <cite ref="R00602"><he>צְמַת</he></cite>.]
Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXIV, 65 (h. text ותתכס).—2) אִצְטַמְטַם (cmp. מזדנזדין, v. זעזע) to be pressed, want.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) <he>אִצְטַמְטְמִינָן לבישרא וכ׳</he> we were pressed for meat (our store of meat had given out).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ואצטמטימתון לחמרא</he> (corr. acc.) and we had no wine; v. <cite ref="R00602"><he>צְמַת</he></cite>.
